opening.argument: The offer asks participants to lock their coins for fixed periods—one year, eighteen months, or twenty-four months—through Coin Save, presented as a OneCoin product. It then attaches stated returns to that commitment: locking 1,000 coins for 12 months allegedly produces an extra 100 coins upfront. The invitation is expressly financial, urging viewers not to miss the product to “earn extra money for free.” Together, the lock-up structure, promised additional coins, and earnings appeal establish an investment-pool, lending, or staking-returns offer, while the claim that coin appreciation can secure the future reinforces its financial pitch.
